judged_text: The members action changes the public GET /groups/:name/members response contract from a bare serialized array to a {members: [...], meta: {total, limit, offset}} envelope, and ships with no spec in this diff pinning the new shape or the pagination logic. Any out-of-tree consumer parsing the old array response (mobile client, plugin, ops script doing .map over the body) now gets an object and breaks at release time, and a future rename of meta.total or the limit default simultaneously breaks both the admin group page and the public members page (both consume findMembers) with no failing test to point at the cause.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does change `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare array) to an envelope `{ members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }` (see `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`). The JS `Discourse.Group#findMembers` was updated to expect `result.meta.*` and `result.members` (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`), and the group members template was adjusted to iterate `members` instead of `model` (`discourse/templates/group/members.hbs`). However, this is still a public response-contract change for `GET /groups/:name/members` and there is no new/updated spec in this diff that pins the new JSON shape or pagination defaults/logic for `GroupsController#members` (only `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` is touched). That makes the concern actionable and diff-grounded, but it’s not a directly verifiable runtime defect within the PR itself.
